name: CCTV_YOLO
description: Fast Real-time Object Detection with High-Res Output https://x.com/_akhaliq/status/1840213012818329826 https://x.com/githubprojects/status/1891370506537910724 https://www.threads.net/@githubprojects/post/DGKdoE4zdUX
readme_summary: This repository implements a fast, real-time object detection system for CCTV surveillance using the YOLOv5n6 model. It achieves high processing speeds by performing inference on low-resolution frames and then drawing the detection results onto high-resolution video streams, all accessible through an interactive Gradio interface.
primary_use_case: Real-time object detection on live video streams, optimized for speed and high-resolution output, suitable for surveillance applications.
cover_image_prompt: A split-screen visual metaphor. On the left, a blurry, low-resolution camera feed shows a busy street scene with faint outlines of people and cars. On the right, a crystal-clear, high-resolution version of the same scene is displayed, with vibrant, precisely drawn bounding boxes clearly highlighting every person and vehicle. A digital magnifying glass hovers over the low-res feed, symbolizing the inference process, while glowing data streams connect it to the high-res output. The repository name 'CCTV_YOLO' is subtly integrated into a digital display on the magnifying glass. The overall style is a clean, modern 3D isometric illustration with a cool blue and orange color palette, emphasizing the contrast between raw data and refined results.

name: PriceGhost
description: A self-hosted price tracking application that monitors product prices from any website.
readme_summary: PriceGhost is a self-hosted price tracking application designed to monitor product prices from any website. It employs a unique multi-strategy extraction system, including JSON-LD, site-specific scrapers, generic CSS, and AI analysis, to accurately determine product prices. Users are presented with a Price Voting Modal to confirm the correct price, ensuring accurate tracking and preventing common price tracking errors.
key_features: Monitors product prices from any website
Multi-strategy price extraction (JSON-LD, Site-Specific, Generic CSS, AI Analysis)
Price Voting Modal for user confirmation of prices
Notifications for price drops, target prices, and stock availability
AI-powered verification and arbitration for price accuracy
primary_use_case: To provide users with a reliable, self-hosted solution for tracking product prices across the web, ensuring accuracy through a unique price verification system and offering customizable notifications.
cover_image_prompt: A vigilant librarian meticulously examining multiple scrolls, each representing a different price extracted from a product page. The librarian is holding a magnifying glass over one scroll, highlighting the correct price, while other scrolls are slightly blurred or show conflicting numbers. Digital particles representing data flow from the scrolls towards a central, clear display showing the product's name and image. Subtle UI elements resembling a voting system are visible on a nearby digital tablet. The scene is set in a cozy, modern library with warm, focused lighting. The overall style is a 3D isometric illustration with clean lines and a vibrant, trustworthy color palette, emphasizing clarity and user control.

name: LemonSees
description: Agentless SOC & GRC platform — monitoring, 39 DBs, threat intel over SSH. Windows desktop app.
readme_summary: LemonSees is an agentless Security Operations Center (SOC) and Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) platform designed for L1/L2/L3 analysts. It leverages SSH connections as the sole means of interaction, eliminating the need for any server-side installations, and provides a comprehensive suite of tools for monitoring, threat intelligence, and incident response directly from a Windows desktop application.
key_features: Comprehensive SOC domains (SIEM/XDR, EDR, NDR, CTI, SOAR, GRC)
Remote log viewing and event correlation (SIEM)
Windows desktop application with light/dark themes
primary_use_case: To provide security analysts with a unified, agentless platform for monitoring, investigating, and responding to security incidents across their infrastructure using only SSH connections.
cover_image_prompt: A wise old librarian sitting at a grand, ornate desk, holding a single, glowing SSH key. With this key, they are effortlessly accessing and organizing vast, interconnected libraries of information represented by floating, translucent books and scrolls. Each book/scroll contains different security domains like 'Threat Intel', 'Network Traffic', 'System Processes', and 'Compliance Rules'. The librarian's actions cause these elements to neatly arrange themselves into organized shelves and dashboards, symbolizing the agentless monitoring and GRC capabilities. Subtle digital particles emanate from the SSH key, connecting to the information. The scene is bathed in a warm, focused light, with a clean, modern aesthetic and a hint of vintage charm. The LemonSees logo is subtly etched into the desk. 3D isometric illustration style.

name: Mekka
description: Experimental source-available SQLite/libSQL backend for human-and-agent-native workflows, with Studio and scoped MCP access.
readme_summary: Mekka is an experimental, source-available backend for SQLite and libSQL, designed for human-and-agent-native workflows. It offers a typed data API, local authentication, object storage, and realtime primitives, with a focus on fast local iteration and self-hosted deployments.
primary_use_case: To provide a compact, experimental backend for developers and AI agents working together on applications, facilitating rapid local development and self-hosted deployments with integrated tools like a Studio.
cover_image_prompt: A skilled artisan meticulously crafting a complex clockwork mechanism, where each gear and spring represents a different software component like authentication, data storage, and real-time updates. The artisan is shown connecting a digital blueprint (representing human input) to a small, glowing AI assistant that is simultaneously assembling parts of the mechanism. Gears are visibly transforming raw data streams into organized, functional outputs. Subtle UI elements showing code snippets and data flow diagrams are integrated into the workshop's background. The scene is a well-lit, modern workshop with a focus on precision and collaboration between human and AI. The style is a 3D isometric illustration with a clean, vibrant color palette, emphasizing the seamless integration and creation process.

name: rubick
description: Modern cross-platform Kubernetes GUI client built with Tauri and Rust
readme_summary: Rubick is a cross-platform desktop client for Kubernetes that aims to provide a more honest and transparent view of cluster status. It differentiates itself by clearly indicating failures and providing detailed explanations for why certain resources might not be functioning as expected, unlike other tools that might present a misleadingly healthy status.
key_features: Honest status reporting (shows failures, not just fields)
Multi-container log viewing with server-side filtering
No account, no telemetry, GPLv3 license
primary_use_case: To provide developers and operators with a transparent and reliable desktop interface for interacting with and monitoring Kubernetes clusters, especially in identifying and diagnosing issues.
cover_image_prompt: A meticulous cartographer standing at a crossroads, holding a magnifying glass over a complex map of interconnected pipes and glowing nodes representing a Kubernetes cluster. One path clearly shows a blockage with a red 'X', and a small scroll unfurls from the cartographer's hand, detailing the specific reason for the blockage (e.g., 'Mismatched Selector', 'Pod Not Ready'). Another path is clearly marked as 'Under GitOps Control - Delayed Update'. Subtle digital particles representing data flow emanate from the nodes. The overall style is a 3D isometric illustration with a clean, modern aesthetic and a color palette emphasizing clarity and trust, with the repository name 'Rubick' subtly etched on the cartographer's tools.
